name: devtools
description: A debugger for Claude Code tool calls: breakpoints, pause/continue/reject/step, a timeline, an inspector, Error Lens failure diagnosis and sanitized trace exports.

recording.title: Record the timeline
recording.description: Record observed tool calls in the session timeline when no saved preference exists.

maxTimelineEntries.title: Timeline size
maxTimelineEntries.description: How many events the in-memory timeline keeps (oldest dropped first).

maxSummaryChars.title: Summary length
maxSummaryChars.description: Longest input or result summary kept per event, in characters.

defaultScope.title: Default breakpoint scope
defaultScope.description: Which agents a new breakpoint applies to when none is given.

headlessPause.title: Headless pause policy
headlessPause.description: What a pause breakpoint does when nobody can answer (claude -p, SDK): reject the call, or only record it.

simulation.title: Allow simulated results
simulation.description: Offer 'Simulate' at a breakpoint for allowlisted tools. Off by default; simulated results are always labeled.

redaction.title: Redact secrets
redaction.description: Redact credentials, tokens and environment values from the timeline and exports.

captureRaw.title: Capture raw inputs and outputs (privacy risk)
captureRaw.description: Also keep raw tool inputs and outputs (still truncated, redacted unless redaction is off). May capture file contents.

persistBreakpoints.title: Persist breakpoints
persistBreakpoints.description: Save breakpoint rules and the debugger mode across sessions in the plugin store.

inlineControls.title: Inline breakpoint controls
inlineControls.description: The 'break on' controls under tool rows and the bar above the prompt: always (a dim line under each row), hover (only while the pointer is over a row; fullscreen terminal and desktop), or off.

openOnStart.title: Open the dashboard on start
openOnStart.description: Open the DevTools dashboard when an interactive session starts (seated only where it docks, 144+ columns).

errorLens.title: Error Lens
errorLens.description: Diagnose failed tool calls: 'probe' also makes read-only file checks (stat only, never contents), 'classify' uses the result alone, 'off' disables it. Never retries or changes a call.

errorToasts.title: Error Lens notifications
errorToasts.description: Show a one-line notification when a tool call fails (the first of a kind, then every fifth repeat).
